practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: The presence of EvoSuite/EvoRunner imports and a generic method name 'test7' are indicators of autogenerated tests; decision rules identify signs of heavy code generation => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: The test appears minimal and written after-the-fact (single autogenerated test with basic operations and no Given-When-Then structure or multiple well-designed scenarios) => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: The test interacts only with public methods of TabelaHash (insere, pesquisa) and does not use reflection or access private internals; decision rules mark as compliant.
Assertions are absent in the method; where present they should be specific and ideally include messages. Decision rule: lack of specific assertions => non-compliant.
No commented-out code or excessive comments are present. The code is concise and does not contain noisy inline comments; class-level Javadoc exists for the marker interface.
The test uses no sources of non-determinism (no Random, time calls, sleeps or external dependencies in the visible code). It relies on local operations only.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories

The test performs two distinct 'Act' operations (two insere(...) calls) in the same method, so it tests multiple operations rather than a single behavior; there is no single Arrange-Act-Assert focused on one requirement.
The test uses only local variables and does not rely on shared mutable state or ordered execution; no @Before/@After is required for this single short test.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows

The test uses boundary-like inputs (an empty string "" and a null value) which constitute explicit edge inputs according to the evaluation criteria.
The test is short and self-contained (<10 lines) and does not duplicate setup across multiple methods, so modularity is acceptable for this single test.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: The test is short (few lines), linear, contains no loops or complex branching and follows a simple flow, satisfying the low complexity criteria.
There are no assertions verifying multiple properties of outcomes; the test contains zero assertions (superficial checks), so it is unlikely to detect subtle faults.
No @Ignore/@Disabled annotations or commented-out @Test methods are present; the test is active and runnable.
There are no annotations, Javadoc, or comments linking the test to any requirement ID, user story, or ticket, so traceability is absent.
